text_block_list.text:
The news of Смарт Фалкон's third straight
victory
at the JBC Classic monopolizes
online trends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although her popularity continues to
grow, she
appears to be focusing less on
individual
impressions and more on the
numerical metrics of
success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, she runs into one of
her first
fans, a girl who says she loves
how Смарт Фалкон
sparkles. But the
Umadol herself can't see her
own
sparkle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing Смарт Фалкон shaken, I decide to
have a
serious talk with her before her
next race, the
Champions Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
